purpose: This table provides a cleaned, deduplicated catalog of global airports sourced from the OurAirports bronze landing table, intended to feed downstream geospatial and operational analytics such as route planning, airport lookups, and regional aviation reporting.
usage: Consumers should treat id as the unique row identifier, join on it when linking to other airport-scoped datasets, and expect nullable text fields (icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, keywords, municipality) to require explicit null handling since they are sparsely populated in source data.
limitations: No duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied; local_code, home_link, and keywords remain highly sparse (63.7%, 74.9%, and 68.0% null respectively) and were not imputed or dropped, so downstream consumers must handle their absence explicitly; elevation_ft retains a 3.7% null rate reflecting missing survey data.
